name: inspector-ai
description: Vertical MVP for AI-assisted construction document inspection

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @inspector-ai/api" "npm run dev -w @inspector-ai/web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:python
scripts.test:providers: node scripts/run-python-tests.mjs bonsai model-store document-ai text-inference gpu-admission
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
